hypotheses.F0_broad_flat_top: At least 25% of masks are within 0.01 fidelity of the best mask at the median site on both corpora.
hypotheses.F1_pairwise_has_selection_skill: Pairwise median held-out regret is at most half random-choice regret and pairwise 90th-percentile regret is at most 75% of random on both corpora.
hypotheses.F2_low_regret_is_only_flatness: The flat-top criterion passes but the pairwise skill criterion fails.
